entities.summary: Lee Roberts is an American professional basketball player for the East Perth Eagles of the NBL1 West. He played college basketball for the Findlay Oilers between 2005 and 2009, where he won an NCAA Division II national championship as a senior. Since 2011, Roberts has had consistent yearly stints in the State Basketball League (SBL) / NBL1 West in Australia. He also consistently played seasons in South America between 2012 and 2024.
